## Design

### 2026-10-05 — Currently finished my  sketches and idea on paper and worked on the PCB for a bit. Currently this project uses 2 50w 8Ohmes speakers with ESP32-S3, ES8388, 3.5 screen, 4 encoders, and a TPA3116D2 amp

**8h**

Currently finished my  sketches and idea on paper and worked on the PCB for a bit. Currently this project uses 2 50w 8Ohmes speakers with ESP32-S3, ES8388, 3.5 screen, 4 encoders, and a TPA3116D2 amp board to amplify the audio input. Currently it has a 1/4" input jack (mono) which runs through the Es8388 which relays to the ESP32  which with the 4 rotary encoders and maybe one 1 button to choose screen which will be able to add effects and eq.
